title: Review complete Project-note history offline before and after Project archival

requirements.invariant: An authorized user can select an active or archived Project by stable Account/Project identity and review its notes without copied names, row position, lifecycle state or caller-supplied Account/Principal becoming relationship or authorization authority.

Archiving changes only Project lifecycle/revision/server update evidence and immutable operation result; every Project note identity, visible text or tombstone, source, creator, audit time, revision and deterministic order remains unchanged and readable through the same authorized Project scope.

Each note has stable identity, structural visible-or-tombstone content, immutable creation provenance, paired edit/deletion audit and exact UInt64 revision. A page contains at most 200 notes ordered by (createdAt,id) descending with a scope-bound keyset cursor and explicit complete-history truth.

One exact-Project on-demand stream synchronizes the complete authorized Project-note history, including archived Projects. Local reads paginate the complete replica; no undefined cap, eviction, tombstone retention, search or server-side ordering/limit policy is invented.

Subscription Account/Project parameters narrow scope but never authorize it. Signed auth identity plus active Account membership governs both Project anchor and notes; revocation removes represented rows/completeness and reactivation requires a new exact-stream completion.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: The app consumes the existing ProjectNoteQuerying port through one Account-bound provider/runtime. Selection, page, runtime and stop generations cancel and drain prior observers; same stable Project active-to-archived transition does not clear or restart its note history.

The exposed note read surface has explicit authenticated SELECT privilege plus row authorization; PUBLIC and anon have none, note INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE have no client grant or policy, and no service-role credential appears in app or MCP code.

The gated MCP derives Account and Principal from authenticated request context, lists bounded notes with precision-safe decimal revision text, and archives through byte-identical project-archive-v1 semantics. It never fabricates local readiness or exposes note writes/search/restore/general Project update/live registration.

All work remains spike-prefixed, synthetic and isolated. Firebase/source data, hosted resources, production, release and cutover remain untouched; A-003/A-004 stay proposed and real authenticated Sync authorization remains a later rehearsal gate.

items: Reuse ProjectNoteData and Project archive Core contracts unchanged; all provider and transport rows reconstruct through those validators.
A note page binds exact Account/Project/page/cursor fingerprint and refuses cross-scope, duplicate, unsorted, malformed or false-complete evidence atomically.

Create one spike_project_notes table with exact parent/actor references, visible/tombstone and paired-audit constraints, finite millisecond-consistent timestamps, integral 0...UInt64.max numeric revision and exact descending keyset index.
Create only a precision-safe security-invoker read surface projecting revision as text; no second physical authority, search structure or cascade is allowed.
The note read transport binds authenticated exact Project scope, reads pageSize+1 through RLS and emits bounded non-enumerating outcomes with canonical decimal revision.
Reuse spike_archive_project byte-for-byte; add no note writer or alternative archive policy.
Revoke all note relation/read-surface/function privileges from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated before granting only the exact authenticated SELECT/EXECUTE privileges required for reads.
No direct note INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE privilege exists.
Enable and force active-membership Account-scoped SELECT RLS on Project notes; views/functions remain security-invoker and cannot bypass the table policy.
Owner/admin/employee active members may read; anonymous, revoked, nonmember and cross-Account callers receive no note or existence disclosure.
One on-demand stream contains exact Project anchor plus complete exact-Project notes for signed active members and never filters archived Projects.
Stream SQL has no ORDER BY, LIMIT, search or note write; local SQLite owns keyset order and page bounds.

The encrypted local schema stores exact note/audit/revision fields and index. The provider reads pageSize+1, emits <=pageSize and establishes complete history only from a new exact current-process stream completion.
Retained restart rows are partial/stale; membership or selection loss hides rows immediately; all row/status observers unsubscribe once and drain before database close.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project-note history in this slice contains no attachment identity, bytes, upload, URL, retention or deletion behavior.

items: The Project browser owns one bounded note-history model and presents waiting, partial, stale, ready, incomplete, authoritative-empty, tombstone, Older and Newest states beside the existing archive flow.
The combined target MCP module exposes only gated list_project_notes and archive_project contracts using scoped-user credentials and privacy-safe bounded failures.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase note is decoded, transformed, deduplicated, imported, quarantined or reconciled in this implementation batch.

items: Diagnostics and telemetry may contain outcome, page size, completeness, phase, bounded error and contract version only; never note text, identity, cursor, command bytes, endpoint, token or key.
Implementation remains local-only in the dedicated target worktree and disposable Supabase/PowerSync stores. Rollback is source reversion and disposal of synthetic data.
No live MCP registration, hosted resource, Firebase change, migration, release or cutover authority is introduced.
